title: Turkish Koi Borek
description: A delicious Turkish-inspired pastry dish filled with koi and spices, served as a breakfast or snack option.

ingredients.name: turkish spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, paprika, and sumac

instructions: Cut phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces.
Mix koi and spices, set aside.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface.
Spread a quarter of the koi mixture onto the phyllo dough.
Top with a quarter of the borek cheese.
Fold the phyllo dough to form a triangle.
Repeat with remaining dough and filling.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
